7 of 9 members present. Quorum established.

Agenda
Item 1
Regional Business Review: EMEA

The Regional Business Review: EMEA was a review of the company's workplace safety record. The number of recordable incidents had decreased by 7% year-over-year. The committee commended the safety team for their efforts.

Motion

To approve for budget: RESOLVED, that the Steering Committee for Project Phoenix endorses the strategic framework for the Regional Business Review: EMEA and directs management to develop a detailed implementation plan for review at the next meeting.

Moved: Rohit Cohen  •  Seconded: Harish Reed
Vote: 4 Yea  /  1 Nay  /  2 Abstain  —  CARRIED
Item 2
Insider Trading Policy Annual Certification

The committee discussed the Insider Trading Policy Annual Certification, a review of the company's response to a recent data breach. The committee was satisfied with the response and directed the CISO to implement additional security controls.

Motion

To enter executive session: RESOLVED, that the Steering Committee for Project Phoenix defers consideration of the Insider Trading Policy Annual Certification to the next scheduled meeting, pending receipt of additional analysis from the responsible owner.

Moved: Rohit Cohen  •  Seconded: Ozge MacMillan
Vote: 4 Yea  /  0 Nay  /  3 Abstain  —  CARRIED
Item 3
Succession Planning Report — Chickasaw Advisory Executive Team

The committee considered the Succession Planning Report — Chickasaw Advisory Executive Team, a proposal to adopt a new policy on charitable contributions. The policy was approved and will be implemented company-wide.

Motion

To adopt: RESOLVED, that the Steering Committee for Project Phoenix establishes an ad hoc subcommittee to further investigate the Succession Planning Report — Chickasaw Advisory Executive Team and report its findings back to the full committee within 90 days.

Moved: Tsehay Katz  •  Seconded: Cecilia Espiritu
Vote: 7 Yea  /  0 Nay  /  0 Abstain  —  CARRIED
